product_metadata.title: Amscan Rainbow Stripe Bandana, 20" x 20", Multicolor
features: PACKAGE INCLUDES: 1 rainbow stripe bandana - 20" x 20"

SUITABLE FOR ALL EVENTS: This bandana is perfect for festivals, costume parties, dress-ups, and other themed events.

description: Cover your face, around your hair or your neck for protection, but best of all for Fashion. This very useful and multi-purpose 20" x 20" Rainbow Bandana is perfect for any special occasion, party or events to complete a costume or get up and most especially for everyday use.
